az_anti_crag.blurb: The Anti-Crag is the busiest wall in West Clear Creek, a sandstone canyon below the Mogollon Rim in central Arizona. It is mainly a crack-climbing venue, with trad routes making up most of the 23 climbs and just a few bolted lines. Grades start around 5.9, cluster in the 5.10 range, and top out in the low 5.12s, so it suits leaders already comfortable placing their own gear. The stone is described as solid and the canyon setting as scenic. The canyon lies inside a federally protected wilderness, and the local tradition is ground-up with very little fixed protection, so expect committing leads. Keep the place clean.
az_anti_crag.approach: From where the trail ends, follow the creek upstream for roughly twenty minutes. The wall is on the north side of the creek, a few minutes past the Grotto.

az_trailer_park.blurb: Trailer Park is a bouldering sector in East Kelly Canyon, in the pines a few miles south of Flagstaff at roughly 7,000 feet. It holds 23 problems on sandstone, with a broad spread: plenty in the easy-to-moderate V0 to V7 range, plus a single standout test piece around V11. Many problems in this canyon are tall, with sloping topouts, so bring several pads and a spotter or two. The sandstone varies from tacky and hard to sandy and crumbly, and it turns fragile when wet, so give it at least a day to dry after rain. Fall is the best time of year; winter snow and closed roads make the canyon a poor choice.

az_ice_castles.blurb: Ice Castles is a cluster of granite boulder piles on desert land north of Phoenix, reached by a long dirt road rather than a paved trailhead. The 23 listed climbs are a mix of sport, top-rope and trad, with grades running from very easy up through the low 5.12s. The bulk fall between 5.7 and 5.10, which makes it workable for newer climbers as well as those after a moderate pump. Some of the boulders are tall, with the biggest around 65 feet. Expect a rough drive that favors a high-clearance vehicle, and close the gate behind you.
az_ice_castles.parking_note: Go in through the gate off Highway 303 eastbound, just before I-17, and close it behind you. The dirt road is about 3 miles and takes 20 to 30 minutes; a high-clearance vehicle handles it best, and washes can wash out.
az_ice_castles.approach: Under 15 minutes on foot if you stop the car as soon as the road gets uncomfortable; the boulders are visible ahead.

az_ireiand_main_wall.blurb: The main wall at Ireland is a bolted sport face in the Upper Highway zone of Mount Lemmon, in the Santa Catalina Mountains outside Tucson, at around 8,000 feet. All 23 routes are sport climbs. Grades begin near 5.7 but the heart of the wall is 5.10 through 5.12, with a good number of 5.10s and a strong run of 5.12s. The wall catches morning shade, which helps in warmer months, and the walk in goes through a forest of dead trees following cairns. Lemmon climbing itself is free of charge, though some developed parking areas on the mountain need a national forest pass. Allow extra time on weekends for traffic on the highway.

az_canyon_area_the.blurb: The Canyon Area is a small group of boulders in the Groom Creek bouldering zone along Senators Highway, south of Prescott, directly east of the Moonstone Area. It has 23 problems across several named boulders. Most are easy, with a big cluster at V0 and V1, a handful in the V3 to V5 band, and a couple of hard outliers well beyond that. Landings in the wider Groom Creek zone are generally good, the stone is mostly sound steel-grey grain, and the setting is open ponderosa forest. A long slabby traverse is the best warm-up. For the main boulderfield, hiking Trail 307 gets you into the heart of it.

az_orifice_wall.blurb: Orifice Wall is a steep, hard sport crag on The Fortress, part of the Summit Crags high on Mount Lemmon above Tucson. Nearly all of its 22 routes are bolted, mostly with fixed chain draws already hanging, and the grades are demanding: a few 5.11s, then roughly equal numbers of 5.12 and 5.13 climbs, with one 5.10 at the bottom. The wall sits in shade for most of the day once late morning arrives, and it handles monsoon rain well.
